target.title: build: update Go SSH security libraries
target.body:
## Summary

- update `golang.org/x/crypto` to v0.53.0 and its compatible `x/sys`, `x/term`, `x/text`, and `x/sync` module graph
- keep coordinatorless generic provider smokes from calling coordinator-only history and logs
- guarantee generic smoke lease cleanup with a subshell `EXIT` trap, including failures after acquisition
- add regression coverage and `0.35.1 - Unreleased` changelog entries

## Verification

- `go vet ./...`
- `go test -race ./... -count=1`
- `govulncheck ./...` — no vulnerabilities found
- `node --test scripts/*.test.js` — 375 passed
- `scripts/check-docs.sh`
- targeted ShellCheck clean after excluding two pre-existing false positives (`SC2016`, provider alias `SC1010`)
- autoreview — clean, no actionable findings

## Exact-head live proof

Built commit `0db57d59cc647403b4834e1602aa631ef9652eb5` and ran the documented coordinatorless live smoke through the real CLI.

- provider: `local-container` (Docker 29.4.0)
- lease: `cbx_c0d45537a08d`
- lifecycle: warmup → SSH → cache inspection → repository sync → remote command → stop
- remote sentinel: `crabbox-xcrypto-exact-head-live-ok`
- result: exit 0; container and local lease claim both absent after cleanup

No persistent credentials or cloud resources were used.
